text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: It's insignificant enough that it won't be a problem. I've been reflecting on what I can do to make the Ligne Droite a success… in terms of what'd truly make the students happy.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text: You don't feel that's the case already?

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's just, perhaps I've only made myself happy. 
Bringing everyone together, making them act lively and dance… 
Leaving no one smiling but me, smug and self-righteous.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text: Do you think so? If anything, shouldn't you be more concerned with your own satisfaction?

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
Even if you do your utmost for the event, what the students get 
out of it is up to them. So all we can do is… give them a 
fantastic performance.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
Kaichou, you know as well as I do that… you can't 
bring anyone excitement if your own heart isn't 
in it, right? You need to be the example.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Фудзи Кисэки. 
I'm sorry, there's somewhere I need to go.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
That's fine, go ahead. 
You can always count on me, I'll be there.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
Well then… 
Shakur, you can come out now. I know you were listening.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You made me hear all that, more like. What do you think you're playing at?

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text: I'm not playing… What kind of person do you all take me for…? I just thought that if you stayed to listen, you might get something out of it.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
We're going to light up this year's dance. If you 
have a little time later on, come over and watch 
us rehearse! I promise you won't regret it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha, like hell you didn't play me. God… Whatever, now I know. 
Somebody caught on, and knows my identity.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And they plan on using me to drag people to the dance? Talk about uncalled for. But… Memories, huh…

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text:
Senpai! Thanks for helping us out with studying. 
You totally saved us for the next test.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you can call it that, yeah. 
You guys pretty much roped me into it. 
Dumbasses, what's gotten into you all?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, cold! Well like, it's that time of year. I wound up thinking 
about the future. Figured I should get some stuff out of the way.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Do I look like insurance? An escape route? Don't make me sick. 
Try that crap again with me and I'll ignore you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie B
text_block_list.text:
A lot's been on my mind. Like, I don't wanna regret anything. 
Whatever happens, I want to be prepared. And I want to make some 
memories. And stuff…

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie B
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm kidding! God, that's corny! 
We're gonna head back! Thanks for today!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
They're weak. 
Regrets can be suppressed. 
And memories are worthless to cling to.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
Hearts are complex, fickle things. 
I think we've both put up walls around our own.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So? Why show up again? 
Don't tell me you're gonna get on your knees and plead.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I've come to ask a favor of you. 
Sirius Symboli, will you lend me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
I've taken your input into consideration. I've thought deeply 
about my intent… to celebrate this milestone, if it would make 
the students happy. And my conclusion, it is based in ego.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then why did you return with the same exact request? 
If you recognize your own ego…?

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: I've decided to fight back, I suppose. I'll put it this way: I do want to feel fulfilled. I want to light the way for everyone, and for my ideals to bear fruit. So yes, I want all of that.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
And in order to do that, I need your help. My voice does reach 
quite far. However, there are limits to that too. Therefore…

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So you want to use me, basically. God, you really… When you 
look down from your ivory tower, don't get carried away.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. I'll help you out. They're going to make 
their choice no matter what I say. That being said, I'm not 
doing this because of you, or for their benefit either.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: This is a reward for you acknowledging your self righteousness. Be grateful, so-called Emperor, Симболи Рудольф!

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
And Sirius Symboli, I would like to invite you to attend as well. 
You're a student of Академия Тайсен, and just as important.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, was that on purpose? 
You really think you're going to convince me to come?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh, is the Emperor so stuffy she doesn't know how to invite someone? Would you like me to teach you the art of sweet talking?

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: …Heh.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: Are you sure it wasn't me who taught you?

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
But let's not waste the opportunity. 
Give me your hand, Sirius. 
We'll continue our lesson from all those years ago.

text_block_list.name: Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three! 
One, two, three! 
That's it! You're amazing, Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Sirius
text_block_list.text:
I am, aren't I? 
Hey Rudolf, I'm gonna get even better. 
I'm the only person who can satisfy you, and you know it!

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
You really haven't forgotten what I taught you. 
You're quite suited to following my lead.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Shut up, will you? And let me lead!

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
I can do that. But it's funny, I wonder why? Compared to our 
childhood, it's much more fun dancing with you now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look at her, all calm and composed. 
Even when we were kids, that attitude disgusted me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So? When do you plan on showing your face? 
Eavesdropping won't earn you any points with me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie B
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, your dancing was just so amazing! 
I felt like I just stepped into a palace! Or something…

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Quit the small talk. What are you here for?
